messages:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] Canary rollout failing: inference-api-canary pods CrashLoopBackOff, 5xx rate +18% (us-west1). Pager -> @jordan_oncall :rotating_light:

jordan_oncall: ack — I'm on it, checking dashboard/logs now

sam_prodeng: any feature flags involved in this rollout?
jordan_oncall: yes, encoder-v2 at 10% via ff-service

maya_sre: canary pods showing repeated OOM and segfaults in logs, HPA spiked from 2 -> 24 in ~2m, CPU top shows lots of hot loops. prometheus: https://prometheus.internal/alert/abc123

jordan_oncall: kubectl -n prod get pods | grep canary
```
inference-api-canary-5d8f 0/3 CrashLoopBackOff 3 2m
inference-api-canary-6k2p 0/3 CrashLoopBackOff 3 1m
inference-api-canary-9zxl 0/3 CrashLoopBackOff 3 30s
```

opsbot: autoscaler: HPA(inference-deployment) scaled from 2 -> 24 due to avg CPU 92% across canaries

liz_support: CS: multiple customers reporting 500s on /v1/generate, ticket #12345 opened and escalated to SRE

jordan_oncall: I'm going to flip encoder-v2 flag to off (kill-switch) to stop further canary traffic. Will announce when done. :warning:

sam_prodeng: confirm - doing a flip in ff-service now
```
# curl -X POST https://ff-service.internal/flags/encoder-v2 -d '{"state":"off"}'
{"flag":"encoder-v2","state":"off"}
```

jordan_oncall: flipped. ff-service shows encoder-v2=off. Observability: new canaries are no longer getting the variant.

maya_sre: after flag flip, new pods starting show normal init; previous crashlooping pods still in backoff. HPA hasn't scaled down yet — recommend manual scale to reduce churn and costs, and rollback canary image to previous stable.
jordan_oncall: starting rollback: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-deployment --to-revision=45`
opsbot: rollout undo initiated for deployment/inference-deployment (rev 45)

maya_sre: note: node-12 drain earlier at 02:01UTC caused pod migration; combined with the new image's memory pattern, it pushed HPA frantic scaling. Might be correlated.

sam_prodeng: monitoring: 5xx rate dropping — baseline reached within ~2m after rollback and flag flip. HPA scaling activity: 24 -> 6 in progress.

liz_support: updating CS ticket and emailing affected customers: low-severity, partial errors for small subset during canary window, now mitigated.

jordan_oncall: handing off to @sam_prodeng for postmortem and follow-up (I'll be available for 10m then off). Adding timeline to incident tracker and tagging pm. :white_check_mark:

sam_prodeng: ack — taking postmortem. Will capture timeline, root cause hypotheses (image memory regression + node drain churn + aggressive HPA), and action items (rollback gating, probe hardening, HPA cooldowns, feature-flag rollback playbook).

incident-bot: Incident resolved (SLA impact: minor partial errors). Logged incident ID INC-2026-03-17-4487654321
